annotations.title: Function selector and event topic for a Solidity signature

description: Function selector and event topic for a Solidity signature. Normalizes a function/event/error signature (drops parameter names, expands uint to uint256, handles tuples and arrays) and returns the 4-byte selector and the 32-byte event topic. No network access. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
name: evm_selector
title: Function selector and event topic for a Solidity signature
